# A bill with no tax entry, applying the cost split of a payment made on a
# card kept as a plain `type: Liability` account, whose tax was separated when
# it was paid.
#
# After the link the transaction is `A/P +100.00 / Liabilities:Tax:GST USD
# +13.00 / Liabilities:Card As Liability USD −113.00`. Both remaining splits
# are the same account type, so no ordering of types can tell the card from
# the tax account. What tells them apart is the sign: the settlement debits
# the payable, and the money went the other way.
#
# What this fixture produces: the bill settled, paid on the card.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-PLAIN-CARD"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-03-26
  entry:
    date: 2026-03-26
    description: "Supplies"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies:USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-03-26
    due: 2026-04-26
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-PLAIN-CARD"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-03-26
    amount: 100
    account: "Liabilities:Card As Liability USD"
    txn_guid: "8f90a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e"
    txn_split_guid: "90a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f"
